metadata.question: In January 2021, did Nambia experience over 7 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The question is about rainfall in Namibia in January 2021, specifically asking if there was over 7 inches of rainfall. I need to: 1. Find precipitation data - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) would be appropriate 2. Define Namibia's geometry 3. Process January 2021 data and calculate total rainfall 4. Convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) 5. Check if the average rainfall exceeds 7 inches For CHIRPS, I'll use 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' which provides daily precipitation in mm. I need to: - Filter for January 2021 (2021-01-01 to 2021-01-31) - Sum the daily precipitation to get monthly total - Convert from mm to inches - Calculate the mean over Namibia - Check if > 7 inches I should also include validation for empty collections and no valid pixels. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [11.7, -28.9], [11.7, -16.9], [25.3, -16.9], [25.3, -28.9], [11.7, -28.9] ]) start_date = '2021-01-01' end_date = '2021-01-31' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(namibia) if chirps.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No precipitation data found for January 2021.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Calculate monthly precipitation sum monthly_precip = chirps.sum() # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) precip_inches = monthly_precip.divide(25.4) # Calculate statistics stats = precip_inches.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True), geometry=namibia, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) mean_precip = stats.get('precipitation_mean').getInfo() pixel_count = stats.get('precipitation_count').getInfo() # 4. Validation & Final Answer print(f"January 2021 Images: {chirps.size().getInfo()}") print(f"Valid Pixels: {pixel_count}") if pixel_count == 0: print("C2") elif mean_precip is None: print("C3") else: print(f"Average Rainfall: {mean_precip:.2f} inches") if mean_precip > 7: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [11.7, -28.9], [11.7, -16.9], [25.3, -16.9], [25.3, -28.9], [11.7, -28.9]
])
start_date = '2021-01-01'
end_date = '2021-01-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(namibia)

if chirps.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No precipitation data found for January 2021.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Calculate monthly precipitation sum
    monthly_precip = chirps.sum()
    
    # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm)
    precip_inches = monthly_precip.divide(25.4)
    
    # Calculate statistics
    stats = precip_inches.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=namibia,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    mean_precip = stats.get('precipitation_mean').getInfo()
    pixel_count = stats.get('precipitation_count').getInfo()
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    print(f"January 2021 Images: {chirps.size().getInfo()}")
    print(f"Valid Pixels: {pixel_count}")
    
    if pixel_count == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif mean_precip is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Average Rainfall: {mean_precip:.2f} inches")
        if mean_precip > 7:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
